html_source:
Molly suspects Leopold has recently had sex as he is hungry, and using intuitive logic, infers it was with a prostitute as, if it was with someone he loved, he’d ‘be off his feed’.

Her thoughts are free-flowing, going from corns to jealous suspicion, but there is a rationale evident in them in comparison to the erratic free association of Stephen Dedalus. In fact, approximately a third of occasions where the word because occurs in Ulysses are in “Penelope”!

That is not to say she is correct. She does add 2+2 and come up with 5 guessing incorrectly with whom Bloom has had sexual encounters.
